 ORDER
The petitions registered as M.V.C.No.822/2024 and M.V.C.No.823/2024 filed under Section 166 of IMV Act are hereby partly allowed.

In M.V.C.No.822/2024, the respondents shall either jointly or severally pay Rs.26,15,800/- (Rupees twenty six lakhs fifteen thousand eight hundred only) with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a., to petitioners towards compensation.

In M.V.C.No.823/2024, the respondents shall either jointly or severally pay Rs.3,32,000/- (Rupees three lakhs thirty two thousand only) with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a., to petitioner Akram towards compensation.
In both the cases, respondent No.2 , insurer of Eicher Goods Carriage vehicle bearing No.AP-03-TE-0779 shall deposit the compensation amount with interest within 3 months from today.
